text:
Olga: heads-up — qint8-ml (multilang candidate) shows embedding-recall drop for Spanish/French prompt slices. Eval shows embed_recall@10 down ~6% for es/fr translation-intent.
Samir: which promptset? multilingual-troubleshoot or i18n-faq?
Olga: multilingual-troubleshoot (es/fr). Ran both token-level and embed-based eval:
```
./eval_harness --model qint8-ml --prompts promptsets/multilang_trouble_2026.json --metrics embed_recall@10,bleurt,bert_score --out /tmp/qint8ml_multilang.json
```
Top-k embed recall drop concentrated on paraphrase translations and synthetic back-translations.
Hannah: interesting. Could be quantizing float->int8 on embedding matmul causing vector distortion. Any patterns by language? Spanish worse than French?
Olga: es ~7% drop, fr ~4.5%. Examples: original prompt in es paraphrased to formal register; baseline embeddings kept nearest gold; qint8-ml moved nearest neighbor to a paraphrase in another intent.
Samir: before humans, run translation-invariant dedupe: we have a tool that normalizes via back-translation and hashes. `python tools/translate_fingerprint.py --input /tmp/qint8ml_multilang.json --langs es,fr --sim 0.9`
(20m later)
Samir: translate-fingerprint report: 14 exact dup (identical after norm), 22 trans-similar (0.88-0.95). That's ~1.4% collisions. Doesn't fully explain the 6% embed recall loss.
Hannah: tag a bilingual micro-golden: sample the 150 worst embed-recall diffs (es+fr), include human bilingual labelers to check semantic parity. @label-bot create-batch --name "qint8-ml-embed-150" --size 150 --golden true --owners Olga,Hannah --lang es,fr --priority high
label-bot: Batch qint8-ml-embed-150 created. ETA 16h. Add :eyes: to allow auto-accept by bilingual seniors.
Samir: spin up quant-sensitivity run focusing on linear-algo variants for embedding projection and kernel precision: `./quant_sweep --model qint8-ml --flags embed_kernel:{stable,fast},kernel_accel:{avx,amt} --out /artifacts/qint8ml_embed_sweep` kickoff in 30m.
Olga: also create a small live probe canary: 0.5% traffic, route multilingual-troubleshoot, but only collect embedding similarity telemetry (top10 cos sims) and user-marked helpfulness. ops-bot please create.
ops-bot: Canary created: canary/qint8-ml-0.5pct-multilang (deploy id 93456). Telemetry set: embed top10 sims, rerank flips, user-helpful events. Retention 72h.
Hannah: labeling plan: bilingual blind relabel, plus forced-backtranslation check: each example will have translator produce backtranslation pair and raters check semantic parity. If bilingual pass-rate < 0.95 or embed-recall delta > 0.04 we hold rollout.
Samir: also run a small embedding-contrast test: compute cosine distance shift distributions between baseline and qint8-ml for gold vs negative examples. Save histogram to the canary dashboard.
Olga: metadata: tag promptset examples with ["qint8-ml-embed-investigation","multilang_trouble_2026"], provenance: eval_run:1819000000, snapshot snap-18190-multi. Saved.
label-bot: Added tags and linked snapshot snap-18190-multi. Human batch owners Olga,Hannah. Expected returns by 2026-03-30 04:00 UTC.
Samir: decision rule: if bilingual gold precision < 0.95 OR cosine mean shift > 0.02 we rollback canary to qint8-ml-stable. Owners: Olga+Hannah.
Hannah: one more: check tokenizer normalization vs baseline (unicode NFKC etc). small normalization drift can cause cross-lingual alignment to break.
Samir: ran tokenizer diff - no drift. I also started a high-precision embedding run (float32) on the failing subset to verify numeric cause.
Olga: thanks. I'll monitor label-bot + embed-sweep. If humans find language-specific regressions we'll expand golden and consider retraining the projection layer. :eyes:
Hannah: good. Keep artifacts attached to snapshot and keep thread for decisions only. Ping infra if canary flags latency/cost spikes.
